title: Give a generated static endpoint deliberate route precedence
goal: Choose which static resource wins when generated asset routes overlap, using explicit endpoint order and verifying the resource actually served.

selectionNotes: Use the .NET11 descriptor only in a version-qualified generated-manifest integration. Public conventions are the normal application alternative on both tested frameworks; this does not add a ninth .NET10 foundation.

prerequisites: Build the complete standalone Web SDK projects below, including both physical assets and isolation files. The fixture acquires real generated manifests from each build output, preserves asset metadata and transforms only a temporary copy before public mapping.
providers: SDK-produced version1 Build endpoint manifest; public MapStaticAssets with an explicit full path, public StaticAssetDescriptor serialization and endpoint conventions; physical web-root files.
constraints: For ordinary application ordering prefer the public endpoint convention; do not hand-edit obj or generated manifests. The advanced descriptor route is a bounded generated-manifest integration, not a universal custom JSON authoring contract.

Order is a nullable string. Missing/null/empty, invalid text and Int32 overflow use -100 in the measured RC2 factory; JSON numeric Order fails parsing. Validate author-owned values rather than relying on silent fallback.
Descriptors freeze before endpoint conventions run. Set Order before serialization/mapping; conventions change RouteEndpointBuilder.Order, never descriptor metadata.

Lower Order is selected first among matching candidates. Route specificity, constraints, method/content negotiation and middleware still matter. Equal competing literal orders can be ambiguous; order is not authorization or fallback policy.
.NET10 lacks descriptor Order; the verified convention approach remains valid. No older-target Order backport, trimming/NativeAOT, arbitrary manifest schema, browser or deployment guarantee.
packageAssets: Microsoft.AspNetCore.App framework reference supplied by Microsoft.NET.Sdk.Web. No restored NuGet libraries or package-native assets; no direct reference to internal build assets.

runtime.name: .NET / ASP.NET Core
runtime.reason: Descriptor Order requires ASP.NET Core 11. Exact execution evidence is RC2, not actual GA.

language.name: C#
language.reason: Tested mode. No C#15-only feature is needed; previous comparison uses C#14.

renderingModes: Server HTTP GET/HEAD; HTML is checked as response bytes. No browser, Blazor or interactive rendering claim.
platforms: Windows x64 is the qualified reproduction lane. Other server platforms and deployment/publish layouts need their own checks; native host identity checks here use Windows file names.

sdk.name: .NET SDK
sdk.reason: The Web SDK generates the static endpoint manifest. Tested pins identify reproduction, not minimum servicing patches.

stabilityLimitations: No ExperimentalAttribute on the actual Order contract. Stable API designation with measured RC2 assets; actual-GA reconciliation PIN-964, comprehensive PIN-959, PIN-963 and unrelated Human gates remain open.
